words.prose: {{ar:عَلَّمَ}} ({{tr:ʿallama}}) is the first action after the one-word divine name in 55:1, so the active singular verb makes the prior name the recoverable teacher while leaving the subject unstated on the surface. Its Form II shape turns the knowledge root outward: not simply knowing, and not a bare notice, but causing knowledge through instruction. The verb normally opens room for a learner and a taught content, yet here only {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانَ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāna}}) is visible, so the content is sharply foregrounded and the recipient remains open. The root's sign and marker family remain a narrowed background payoff: the taught recitation is made knowable and recognizable, but the local branch is still teaching. Cross-passage and same-surah links reinforce that this is a teaching formula, with primordial instruction in 2:31, the poetry contrast in 36:69, the human plea for knowledge in 20:114, the recitation command in 73:20, and the later taught expression in 55:4 all sharpening the local act rather than replacing it. Even the cadence matters: the pressed doubled middle consonant and the compact verb launch the clause before the longer object settles it.

topics.reason: The Form II verb locally selects teaching or causing to know, while related knowing, learning, and notification forms help define what the selected form is not.

topics.reason: The verb governs the following accusative object directly, while no overt learner appears; the one-object surface is locally real even if the broader verb can license two participants.

topics.headline: sign-bearing root pressure kept as background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that instruction is not abstract transfer only; the root family lets teaching make the recited object recognizable as marked knowledge.
topics.reason: V4 accepts sign and landmark branches for the root, but the local PV:II verb selects teaching, so the marker image survives only as lexical pressure, not as the main gloss.

topics.reason: The word stands first in the ayah and bears the Form II doubled middle radical, so the order and sound observations are locally anchored.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانَ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāna}}) is the visible payload of the two-word clause: its accusative ending makes it the taught content of {{ar:عَلَّمَ}} ({{tr:ʿallama}}), while its definite article presents it as an identifiable title rather than a new indefinite act of reciting. The root and noun shape keep two payoffs together: it is voiced recitation and also a gathered whole, so the object taught is both performance and organized corpus. The ayah chooses the knowledge-root verb for causation and the recitation-root noun for the object, even though the recitation root itself can supply a causative reading verb; that split makes teaching and recitation cooperate across two roots. Cross-references sharpen the local profile: in 27:6 a receiver is named, in 36:69 the object is described as reminder and clear recitation, in 73:20 people are commanded to recite, and in 55:4 a second taught object enters the same local series. The closing word also carries sound pressure: qiraat evidence preserves the same referent while the hamza may be pronounced or smoothed, so the title's recitable form remains part of the payoff without changing its identity.

topics.headline: recognized title under direct verbal government
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun is not a loose title; case, definiteness, and closure make it the known object taught by the verb.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence agree that the noun is definite, accusative, and the direct object of the verb; this supports the CRITICAL object-weight rows.

topics.headline: recited act and gathered whole together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taught object is both something voiced as recitation and something gathered as an organized whole.
topics.reason: The accepted root branches include reciting and gathering speech, and the local definite noun can carry both the action/product force and the recognized named object.

topics.headline: teaching verb and recitation noun divide the work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that causation is carried by the teaching root while the recitation root supplies the taught object, joining the two semantic fields in immediate syntax.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes the recitation noun the object of the knowledge-root teaching verb; related causative possibilities in the recitation root remain comparative, not locally selected.

topics.headline: local object placed among title and recitation passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how this object-defined teaching clause contrasts with named receiving in 27:6, descriptive reminder language in 36:69, human recitation in 73:20, and the second taught object in 55:4.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references that illuminate the local object as taught content without overriding its grammar.

topics.headline: recitable form varies at the hamza without replacing the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title's acoustic edge is part of its recitational identity, while qiraat smoothing keeps the same taught referent.
topics.reason: The qiraat and phonetic rows support a form-and-sound payoff, but the variation is narrowed to articulation because it does not change the local referent or syntactic role.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative عَلَّمَ takes ٱلْقُرْءَانَ as its direct object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Teaching causes what is not yet clear to become knowable, while the object names reading, reciting, and teaching recitation; disclosure becomes transmissible performance.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic transition enacted by the causative verb.
Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation supply the performed and retransmissible content of the object.

changed_reading.before: A body of information called the Qur'an was conveyed.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is caused to become clear as a recitable practice that can itself be taught onward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَلَّمَ can activate marking and guidance, while قُرْءَان can activate gathering and a directed pattern.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispersed material is gathered into a patterned whole, and that whole functions as a distinguishing mark by which a route can be found.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points onward turns teaching into orientation rather than mere transfer.
Collecting and gathering make many elements available as one navigable whole.
A manner, pattern, and directed course give the gathered whole an orienting trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Teaching adds Qur'anic content to memory.
changed_reading.after: Teaching gathers material into a patterned waymark by which perception and movement can be oriented.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object قُرْءَان carries a branch image of a womb enclosing pregnancy, while عَلَّمَ carries emergence into knowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The taught object can be carried as an enclosure of developing potential: disclosure brings forth what has been held and formed within it.

activation_trace.role: A womb enclosing pregnancy supplies the branch-distant image of held, developing capacity within the Qur'an.
Becoming clear to a knower supplies emergence from latent formation into apprehension.

changed_reading.before: A finished lesson is handed to an already formed learner.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is taught as a capacity-bearing enclosure whose contents form and emerge in the learner.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy opens a womb image, the focus places a pregnancy-enclosing Qur'an inside disclosure, and creation then appears as measuring and forming; teaching can function as a merciful formative matrix.

activation_trace.role: A womb enclosing pregnancy makes the focus object capable of carrying developing human potential.
The literal female womb supplies a merciful enclosure immediately before the focus act.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supply the formation that follows the pedagogical enclosure.

structural_cues: 55:2 stands between ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ in 55:1 and creation of the human in 55:3, textually placing teaching before the learner's creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb, enclosure, measurement, and the mercy-teaching-creation order; I infer that the order can stage teaching as formative causation; alternatively it may mark rhetorical priority without temporal or ontological preformation.

changed_reading.before: An already created human receives Qur'anic instruction.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is taught as a merciful formative matrix in which human capacity is measured and conceived before the created learner appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gathers material into Qur'an; the repeated teaching construction then gives the human separation, disclosure, and articulation. Gathering and distinguishing become complementary operations.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the compositional operation by which plurality becomes Qur'an.
A second act of disclosure repeats the focus pedagogy and transfers its operation to the human.
Separation and differentiation prevent the gathered whole from becoming an undivided mass.
Disclosing meaning through speech or sign makes distinction an articulable human capacity.

structural_cues: 55:4 repeats عَلَّمَ with a human pronoun and ٱلْبَيَانَ, closely paralleling 55:2.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated teaching syntax plus gathering, separation, and sign-mediated disclosure; I infer that the second lesson reveals the operating method of the first; alternatively the clauses may list separate gifts.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is a collection whose unity is the endpoint of teaching.
changed_reading.after: Teaching continually gathers elements into Qur'an and articulates the distinctions that keep their relations intelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root can hold cycle-period and appointed-time images; the immediately following calculated luminaries activate a pedagogy of measured return, where a recitation arrives differently at successive intervals.

activation_trace.role: A cycle period of menstruation and purity supplies recurrent crossing between distinguishable states.
An appointed time arriving or being delayed makes understanding seasonable rather than uniformly available.
The moon and its celestial light supply the recurrently encountered body placed under calculation.
Counting and calculation impose measure on recurrence and make return a calibrated cadence.

structural_cues: 55:5 follows the two teaching clauses and places the sun and moon together under one calculation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cycle-period and appointed-time potentials inside ق ر ء followed by a moon under reckoning; I infer recurring, measured return as a learning cadence; alternatively 55:5 may illustrate cosmic order without prescribing reading practice.

changed_reading.before: Teaching the Qur'an is a completed, one-time transfer.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an teaches through calculated returns in which the same recitation ripens at newly appointed intervals.

context_deltas.mechanism: A directed Qur'anic pattern becomes a standard for comparing relations: readings are weighed together, checked against overflow beyond a limit, and checked against loss by under-measurement.

activation_trace.role: A manner, pattern, and directed course provide the focus-anchored standard for calibration.
Balancing and aligning two things supply comparison without forcing either side to disappear.
Crossing a limit in transgression supplies the upper failure mode of an overextended reading.
Justice and equity supply the norm governing how competing details receive weight.
Giving short measure supplies the lower failure mode in which a relevant detail counts for too little.

structural_cues: 55:7 establishes the balance, 55:8 forbids excess in it, and 55:9 commands equitable weight while forbidding diminution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alignment, limit-crossing, equity, and short measure; I infer that these operations can govern how the taught Qur'an is read; alternatively the sequence may concern cosmic and commercial justice without an interpretive method.

changed_reading.before: Knowing the Qur'an means possessing its statements.
changed_reading.after: Being taught the Qur'an includes calibration: holding readings in proportion while resisting both excess and erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation repeatedly gathers each newly disclosed domain under the same question of denial; teaching proceeds as retrieval and recognition under challenge, not uninterrupted exposition.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the repeatable performance through which the lesson returns.
Gathering lets each changing scene be recollected under one stable interrogative frame.
Contradiction of truth supplies the resistance against which repeated recognition is tested.

structural_cues: The refrain first heard in 55:13 returns after successive domains through 55:77 with the same denial question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, gathering, and a recurring challenge to denial; I infer that repetition functions as iterative assessment and re-indexing; alternatively it may be doxological rhythm without an examination mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an teaches by moving linearly from proposition to proposition.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an teaches recursively, returning the reader to one question after each new field until recognition survives variation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering becomes controlled encounter rather than fusion: streams meet, an interval remains, neither crosses its limit, and a concealed pearl emerges. Distinct readings can coexist and generate insight without homogenization.

activation_trace.role: Gathering brings distinct materials into one field of attention.
Two opposed things arriving face to face supply encounter without deciding merger.
The middle interval between two things supplies relational space that preserves difference.
Transgressing a boundary supplies the prohibited collapse of one reading into the other.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the production of insight from bounded encounter.
The literal pearl supplies a discrete valuable result that emerges without erasing its sources.

structural_cues: 55:19 releases two seas to meet, 55:20 inserts a barzakh and denies transgression, and 55:22 presents pearl and coral as emergence from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encounter, an intervening middle, non-transgression, and valuable emergence; I infer that the streams can model coexisting readings and the pearl their abductive yield; alternatively the passage may remain a material sign with no hermeneutic arrow.

changed_reading.before: Gathering Qur'anic material means resolving differences into one undivided reading.
changed_reading.after: Teaching gathers distinct readings into bounded encounter, preserving their limits so that a new insight can emerge between them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus mark becomes spatially operational: amid broad moving water, a raised visible sign gives orientation. The taught Qur'an does not stop motion but lets motion continue without disorientation.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the focus-anchored function of orientation.
Flowing and moving freely supply the changing medium through which guidance operates.
Abundant broad water supplies a field too extensive to navigate by isolated facts.
The visible landmark repeats the focus root's guiding mark inside the sea scene and spatializes teaching.

structural_cues: 55:24 presents constructed or raised vessels moving in the sea كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ, reactivating the focus root in a mobile spatial scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flowing vessels, broad water, and visible landmarks; I infer a navigation arrow from mark to route-finding; alternatively the comparison may concern only size or elevation.

changed_reading.before: The taught Qur'an is content acquired and retained.
changed_reading.after: The taught Qur'an is a visible landmark that keeps a learner oriented while meanings and circumstances remain in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perishable instances fall away while an enduring source remains active in each bounded time and culminates in stable, growing good. One Qur'anic pattern can remain itself while teaching anew through changing affairs.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time arriving makes each renewed disclosure answer to a concrete interval.
A stable manner and directed course let one pattern persist across changing instances.
Cessation and departure after persistence supply the loss of each temporary configuration.
Continuance and remaining supply the stable pole against which passing forms are read.
A bounded duration supplies the recurring temporal frame for a fresh teaching event.
An affair, condition, or event supplies the changing case in which the stable pattern becomes newly legible.
Stable, growing good supplies an ending in which endurance is generative rather than inert.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 juxtaposes universal passing, divine remaining, and a new affair in every day; 55:78 closes with enduring increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perishing, remaining, bounded time, changing affairs, and stable growth; I infer a persistent pedagogical pattern with renewed instantiations; alternatively these clauses may describe divine action without a theory of rereading.

changed_reading.before: The taught Qur'an is static because its lesson is fixed once delivered.
changed_reading.after: Its stable pattern teaches anew in each passing circumstance, preserving identity while producing fresh disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the visible upper-lip cleft is a remote nominal branch, not the ordinary sense or morphology of عَلَّمَ; it remains anchored in that focus root, the recitation branch of قُرْءَان, and nearby disclosure through speech or sign; downstream prose should carry it only as a speculative embodied image of articulation, never as a lexical replacement for 'taught.'

Meaning disclosed through speech or sign keeps the bodily image tied to communicative articulation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, teaching the Qur'an also opens an embodied channel in which hidden meaning becomes articulated recitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because its context is forensic recognition of wrongdoers, not education; it remains valid as a structural activation because the focus mark, recognition after a trace, and a visible identifying sign converge; downstream prose must qualify it as an analogy of knowledge becoming legible in conduct, not an equation of learners with criminals or a claim of physical branding.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mark-and-guidance branch of عَلَّمَ allows taught knowledge to be tested as a distinguishing trace.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, being taught the Qur'an leaves a differentiating trace by which orientation becomes legible in the learner.

strongest_changes: Teaching shifted from post-creation information transfer to a possible merciful preformation of human capacity.
Gathering was revised by bayan and the bounded seas into a gather-and-distinguish operation that preserves coexisting readings.
Cycle, reckoning, balance, and refrain made the pedagogy temporal, calibrating, and recursively interrogative.
Sea-borne landmarks turned taught knowledge from possessed content into orientation within continuing motion.
summary.what_was_special: Two words sustained irreducible images of disclosure, recitation, gathering, waymark, womb, cycle, appointed time, pattern, and bodily articulation; later context strengthened several without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The mercy-teaching-creation order may indicate rhetorical priority rather than temporal or ontological preformation.
Calculated celestial order may activate timely rereading without prescribing it.
Sea, navigation, balance, and forensic marks are cross-domain mechanisms rather than lexical senses of the focus clause.
The oral-cleft activation is intentionally branch-distant and should remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Teaching as disclosure of a gathered whole.** `ع ل م/B001` (a thing becoming clear to a knower) works with the `ق ر ء/B001` variant “gathering speech into recitation.” Their adjacency supplies disclosure plus gathering; I infer that teaching enables dispersed signs to be apprehended as an ordered whole. The ayah reads as cognitive assembly, not simple transfer of information.
2. **Recitation as a model of measured order.** The gathering variant of `ق ر ء/B001` is activated by celestial reckoning and the balance (55:5–9). I supply the analogy that gathered utterance and measured cosmos share ordered relation. The taught Qur'an reads as an audible counterpart to the packet's calculated and balanced structures.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:24 uses `ع ل م/B002` for mountain-like landmarks. That later physical “mark that points” makes teaching in 55:2 also legible as orientation: what is taught becomes a navigational marker through the surah's changing scenes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`ق ر ء` `B001` — “gathering speech into recitation,” with `ع ل م` `B001` — “teaching.”** Structural cue: the compact object `ٱلْقُرْءَانَ` precedes creation and the second teaching clause, and 55:5 then presents calculable celestial order. Assigned role: gathering makes the taught object an ordered verbal whole rather than disconnected utterances. Packet evidence is the root inventory plus the sequence of teaching, creating, articulation, and reckoning. Inference: gathered recitation is the first instrument by which created human perception is organized. Reading change: the ayah depicts transmission of a coherent ordering medium, not an unspecified lesson.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:7 supported the gathered-recitation activation by introducing an installed balance; the later ayah made verbal gathering look like one instance of a wider ordering logic.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A merciful source imparts knowledge; recitation gathers speech, expression discloses meaning, and sensory recognition receives it.

Recitation first gathers articulated material; teaching makes it known; and *bayān* opens the gathered material into an evident meaning that can be seen, heard, or inwardly detected. Mercy supplies the social and affective frame for this movement from held knowledge to intelligible expression.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnızca deniz karşılığındadır; odak dalın kuyu seçeneği komşuda bulunmaz, komşunun büyük ırmak ve genel su genişliği ise odak dalın tanımına girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyudaki kovadan dökülen veya havuza taşan suyu, kokusunu ve taşma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: suyu bol kuyu ile kuyu suyu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kuyu çevresinde suyun çokluğu ve görünür birikimiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suyu taşıyan kuyuyu niteler; komşu dal ise kuyudan dökülen suyu ve taşma sürecini merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Deniz karşılığını açıklayan geniş su dalı ile kuyu çevresindeki bol su dalı seçildi; diğer adaylar gölet, artık su, taşkın veya su tutan arazi gibi farklı taşıyıcı ve süreçlere bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden yırtıcı kuş için verir ve geçici dal görüntüsünü doğrular. Çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi ise kuş adından türetilmiş ayrı bir biçimdir; kuşun tanımına doğrudan katılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yırtıcı kuş adıdır; çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi yalnızca bu addan türeyen biçime bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş adını tanımlar; insan nitelemesi türemiş bir sözcüksel uzantı olarak bağımlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğan veya atmaca türünden bir yırtıcı kuş adıdır. Bu kuş adından türetilen bir niteleme, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği anlatır.

facets.statement: Ad, doğan veya atmaca türünden avcı bir kuşu gösterir.
Kuş adından türeyen insan nitelemesi, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığında yırtıcı kuş adı ile bu addan türetilmiş çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesini birlikte sunar.

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcı kuş sınıfını ve doğan ile atmaca karşılıklarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adından türemiş insan nitelemesinin kullanıldığı bağlama özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğan ve atmaca çevresindeki avcı kuş adlandırmaları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı kuş alanını paylaşsalar da komşu dal renk ve ara tür özellikleriyle daha dar bir kuşu adlandırır; odak dalın türemiş insan nitelemesi de komşuda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca türünü genel bir adla karşılar ve bu addan insan nitelemesi türetir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle zeki ve keskin bakışlı doğanlara verilen bir adı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: doğan adı ile zeki doğan nitelemesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal doğan türünden yırtıcı kuşları adlandırır ve zekâ çağrışımını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda zekâ kuştan türetilen insan niteliğinde belirginleşir; komşuda ise doğrudan belirli doğanların özelliğidir.
